title: Scaling-Score Conformal Prediction for Multi-Target Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.17091v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-target regression requires a model to simultaneously predict several related outputs. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free, finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees, but extending these to joint multi-dimensional regions in a model-agnostic, sample-efficient manner remains challenging: max-aggregation ignores scale differences, copula-based methods are only asymptotically valid, rectangular methods typically split the calibration set, and quantile or density-based methods require training a specialised model beyond a plain point predictor. We propose the scaling-score conformal method, which is model-agnostic (requires only component-wise absolute residuals), uses a single calibration set, and yields four nested output types: an outer rectangle (SCO) with valid joint coverage, the exact set R $\alpha$ , a staircase (SC 2 ) over approximation of R $\alpha$ , and an inner rectangle (SCI). A single hyperparameter $\gamma$

translated_title: 面向多目标回归的缩放得分保形预测
translated_abstract: 多目标回归要求模型同时预测多个相关的输出。保形预测提供了无分布、有限样本的边际覆盖保证，但以模型无关且样本高效的方式将这些保证扩展到联合多维区域仍然具有挑战性：最大值聚合方法忽略了尺度差异，基于copula的方法仅在渐近意义下有效，矩形方法通常需要拆分校准集，而基于分位数或密度的方法则需要在普通点预测器之外训练专门的模型。我们提出了缩放得分保形方法，该方法与模型无关（仅需要逐分量的绝对残差），使用单一校准集，并能产生四种嵌套的输出类型：具有有效联合覆盖保证的外部矩形（SCO）、精确集合R_α、对R_α的阶梯状（SC2）近似，以及内部矩形（SCI）。一个超参数γ
tldr: 提出了一种与模型无关、仅使用单一校准集的缩放得分保形预测方法，用于多目标回归，可生成具有有效联合覆盖保证的四种嵌套输出区域。
en_tdlr: A model-agnostic scaling-score conformal prediction method for multi-target regression that uses a single calibration set and yields four nested output regions with valid joint coverage guarantees.
